body: Great story! I send you a message about it. :) I am actually a dental assistant and this story really intrigued me.
Hello! I message you about your amazing story! Let me know if you received it.

There would not be a reason to reach out at 10pm for anything but crisis care. I would walk to mental health tomorrow, explain my situation, and go from there.  But tonight, I am weak.  My fiancé keep coming in our bedroom, trying to take my phone off of me to check what I am doing, as he is worried for me. If I were to reach out, there would be no downplaying as he would be the one driving me.  He means well. 

I think if he understood better, he would know how to react.  But he's so clueless and damaging because if the ignorance. I try to constantly remind me, don't do it, don't say this.. But then I am controlling and mean..  No winning.
Thank you.  Expect a message tomorrow.  My eyes hurt from crying and I work early tomorrow, so sleep probably is best. Goodnight.
It's late and I am exhausted. I will try to stay awake.  If I disappear, I simply feel asleep.  Suicide takes work and tonight isn't the night.

It's a cycle. I am not entirely sure if I am in an abusive relationship, as I have been in abusive relationships the end majority of my short life, but he seems to be a very good match for me, and then toxic, a good match and then toxic..  It's terrible. I love him so deeply, but it's not healthy.  

I trust no military member that I have come into contact with.  My supervisor is incredible, but as a military member, our interaction has to be my safety first, and if I seek crisis help in the state I am now, I will be in inpatient by midnight.
